assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Production raster art for a Chinese Primary 2 browser learning game, illustration only. Warm gouache and colored-pencil children's textbook illustration, pale warm cream paper, soft watercolor texture, clean expressive forms, gentle sunlight, muted blue/green/yellow palette. A consistent ordinary East Asian boy age seven with short tousled black hair, rounded friendly face, black eyes, blue short-sleeved T-shirt, dark blue shorts, normal believable child anatomy, two arms and two hands. No words, letters, numerals, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere.
Create a perfectly square 2048 by 2048 image, exact FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, every cell 512 by 512, row-major reading order. NO gutters, NO borders, no inset frames. Keep everything for one vignette inside its own square. Same boy across all sixteen. Each vignette must communicate one precise concept with a single clear scene. Row 1 cells: (1) boy standing with BOTH EYES visibly tightly CLOSED, hands down. (2) boy BITING a fresh yellow lemon wedge at mouth, sour beginning expression. (3) boy touching a large clear blue ICE CUBE with his BARE right hand, cube on table. (4) boy walking into clearly falling RAIN wearing only blue shirt and shorts, NO umbrella and NO raincoat. Row 2 cells: (5) boy visibly SQUEEZING a very WET yellow SPONGE over a bowl, water streams out. (6) boy using a felt board eraser to WIPE a simple blue STAR drawing on a WHITEBOARD, partial star still visible. (7) boy has just opened fingers to RELEASE an unsupported yellow PENCIL above the FLOOR, pencil floating below his hand with clear gap. (8) boy CLAPPING his two hands together at chest level. Row 3 cells: (9) boy with CLOSED EYES; beside him a dark dim thought bubble contains a nearly hidden toy ball, clearly unable to see. (10) boy eating lemon with obvious SOUR face, pursed mouth and squeezed-shut eyes, lemon visible. (11) boy's bare hand touching ICE cube with blue CHILL lines and startled cold face. (12) boy standing in rain with visibly DRIPPING WET blue clothes, water droplets and wet darker fabric, no umbrella or coat. Row 4 cells: (13) close view same boy compressing yellow sponge, several unambiguous WATER streams squeezed into bowl. (14) same boy beside an entirely BLANK clean WHITEBOARD, a felt eraser in hand; the previous star has been erased completely. (15) boy WATCHING a yellow PENCIL FALL down below open empty hand, strong downward motion marks, floor underneath. (16) same boy hears CLAPPING: his hands clapping at chest with orange curved SOUND arcs around hands, ear visible and listening smile. Make each prompt's exact objects visible, all cells square. No extra props or limbs. No text.

QA.grid: Borderless 4×4 square cells; use fractional pixel crop boundaries or percentage positioning.
findings: All sixteen requested concepts visible in correct row-major order.
Rain scenes contain no umbrella or raincoat.
Released/falling pencil unsupported beneath open hand.
Whiteboard changes partial star to blank board.
Normal child anatomy, consistent blue-shirt East Asian boy, no writing.
